_readme: Everything a member changes lives here. Run: python3 build.py && npx --yes hyperframes@0.9.83 check --json. Numbers come from SPEC.md.
_note: Example config, not real content. 'lines' must be your exact spoken words in order, split into one-line phrases of 3-6 words (build.py checks them against words-cut.json and stops if they don't match). Shot durations and type positions are example values from a 17.7 s demo take.

shots.note: one locked-off talking-head hold (cut.py); dur = the length of your cut.mp4

_voice_note: Optional separate voiceover file in assets/ (for hands/process footage). null = the voice is on the shot.
_music_note: Optional, not shipped: {"src": "assets/music/your-bed.m4a", "volume": 0.126} (18 dB under the voice). A missing file is left out; or add music in the Edits window yourself (library music goes silent in Claude exports).
lines: one short line at a time,
in the order you say it,
_title_note: Optional static title for hands footage: {"lines": ["line one", "line two"], "start": 0, "end": null}.
_bookend_note: Optional: {"dur": 1.2} repeats the opening shot at the end so the loop is invisible (object footage).
